notes: Similar titles but genuinely different events: title overlap stays below the 0.7 intra-run dedup threshold and below the 0.6 state merge threshold, so both survive as separate events.

stories.title: Example City Municipality Announces New Water Supply Schedule
stories.summary: The municipality published a revised water supply timetable for all wards starting next week.
stories.why_it_matters: Households need the new supply windows for daily planning.

stories.title: Example City Municipality Announces New Road Repair Schedule
stories.summary: Ward-level road repair works are scheduled across Example City with temporary diversions during works.
stories.why_it_matters: Commuters should expect short diversions on repaired stretches.
